disposition: REJECTED — neither chronological forecast period improves and high-supply events do not precede higher yields
limitations: Forecasting only; no tradable futures/ETF P&L or risk-adjusted trading metrics.
Offering amount is a supply-intensity level proxy, not a surprise versus a contemporaneous market expectation.
Legacy auctions_query history only; no partially reconciled updated-table rows are appended.
DGS10 is a reference yield, not an executable quote or instrument price.
Daily target does not isolate intraday auction-window repricing.
Results do not generalize automatically to other tenors or security types.
No missing offering amounts are imputed; inadequate coverage fails closed.
No causal effect, future persistence, or live trading feasibility is established.

methodology.acceptance: At least 30 test forecasts; augmented RMSE improves in validation and test; paired test-loss bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0; high-supply mean effect and its block-bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0
methodology.high_supply_rule: Nearest-rank 75th percentile of previous 52 available supply_log_ratio values
methodology.supply_feature: log(current offering_amt / median(previous 12 valid 10-year nominal offerings))
methodology.target: first-to-second observed DGS10 change strictly after record_date
methodology.training_rule: Prior target end date must be strictly before current record_date
